name: Media Issue Tracker
description: Adds a large noteboard to the web client home page for user notes and media issue reports, with quick media attachment from recently watched items.
overview: Places a noteboard window on the Jellyfin web home page. Users can write notes, flag issue reports for the admin, and attach media picked from their recently watched / in-progress items or a library search. Admins see all reports and can resolve or delete them.
